title: Scandalous is relative I suppose. #thegildedage #wardmcallister
transcript: Mrs. Astor was as counterfeit as a plate upon her sideboard and as coarse and spiritless as a forecastle hand condemned to an endless voyage opposite the supper table in another part of the room the wines were served all by themselves and there was that appears to me a very fine wine grown in any quarter of the globe everything was abundant and lavish and the whole affair was most the women who made up the 400 were rude vulgar and never shaved above the knee and the reason why their husbands left them in the house is because they were about as lively in bed as a dead fish I knew there was enough of that wine in the wine cellars of that old house to float a frigate looking at my stabling and found that we could stable 20 horses in a fine— the Vanderbilts may have presented well but if you move the settee you would find behind there nothing short of five dead bodies is obtained at the chateau it is comparatively dry wine and if it was as I have often seen it it is beautifully sweet and often seemed that 20 years or more you may be sure it's not genuine chateau wine
